This folder contains the runtime executables, their required shared FFmpeg DLLs,
the distributor-supplied LGPL v3 license, exact build information, and hashes.
Development headers, import libraries, HTML manuals, presets, and ffplay.exe were
not copied because Cat Clip Composer does not use them. The shared DLLs remain
separate and replaceable by interface-compatible builds.

The build enables LGPL-compatible integrations for common formats, codecs, fonts,
network protocols, and hardware APIs. They include iconv, zlib, libxml2, VMAF,
Fontconfig, HarfBuzz, FreeType, FriBidi, Vulkan, shaderc, Vorbis, GMP, XZ/LZMA,
LCEVC, OpenCL, AMF, AOM, aribb24/aribcaption, Chromaprint, dav1d, NV codec
headers, Game Music Emu, Kvazaar, libass, libbluray, JPEG XL, LAME, Opus,
libplacebo, RIST, libssh, Theora, VPX, WebP, ZeroMQ, LV2, oneVPL, OpenAL,
OpenAPV, OpenCORE AMR, OpenH264, OpenJPEG, OpenMPT, rav1e, Schannel, SDL2,
Snappy, SoXR, SRT, SVT-AV1, TwoLAME, uavs3d, VAAPI, VVenC, zimg, and zvbi.
The pinned BtbN build-script tag above is the authoritative per-component source
and commit manifest. Those projects retain their own LGPL-compatible MIT, BSD,
Apache, ISC, zlib, MPL, FTL, LGPL, and similar license terms.
